title: Get the Hell Out
staging:
Scene 16 — Get the Hell Out

14:20–15:10 · 50 sec · Restaurant service exit

A guard discovers the security breach. Onyx intercepts the pursuing guards while Neon activates the last bone decoy. The cats escape through the rain-soaked service alley.

Shots: Alarm light → fast corridor tracking → Onyx blocking a doorway → bone decoy bouncing → rooftop escape wide.
